title: Scalar compatibility of the canonical first-localization cohomology map
statement: Let R,A,Aq,B,D be commutative rings in one universe, with R-algebra structures on A,Aq,B, an A-algebra structure on Aq compatible with R, and algebra structures from A tensor_R B and Aq tensor_R B to D. Assume the R- and B-module derived categories exist. Let Q be a complex of A-modules and L,K base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for Q and Aq tensor_A Q. Let uQ be an R-complex map whose degree-j component sends x to 1 tensor x. For i in Z let c be the B-linear cohomology map obtained by composing L.cohomologyIso(i), H^i of L.derived(uQ) followed by the unique universal-counit-compatible isomorphism L.derived -> K.derived, and K.cohomologyIso(i) inverse. For every e in A tensor_R B and x in L.cohomology(i), c(e*x)=phi(e)*c(x), where phi(a tensor b)=algebraMap(A,Aq)(a) tensor b. No localization hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8, derived change of rings and the affine cohomology localization identity

proof.text: On the underlying R-complexes, the generator formula for uQ and tensor balancing intertwine multiplication by a with multiplication by algebraMap(A,Aq)(a). Apply the quotient, derived functor, and cohomology; naturality of the universal comparison and both cohomologyIso_smul fields give compatibility with a tensor 1.

The composite c is B-linear. Decompose a tensor b as (a tensor 1)*(1 tensor b); apply the first-factor result and B-linearity. Tensor induction with additivity and zero proves the equation for every coefficient.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8; class-level consequences and explicit universal-counit model transport
